programme.desc: Los investigadores, Nick Groff y Katrina Weidman, se sumergen entre los espíritus del Old Sweet Springs Resort de Virginia Occidental. Durante una investigación de 72 horas descubren que hay algo debajo de la superficie de los manantiales.

programme.title: Ed Stafford: Rituales del mundo
programme.desc: Ed conoce a los hamer, unos ganaderos etíopes que deben saltar una fila de toros para ser considerados hombres. Ed también debe controlar a estos enormes animales y saltar sobre ellos. Es realmente peligroso, sin exagerar.

programme.title: Ed Stafford: Rituales del mundo
programme.desc: Para la mayoría de la gente, dominar el kung fu Shaolin lleva años. Ed solo tiene unos pocos días para aprender a controlar su Qi, o fuerza vital, antes de enfrentarse a un maestro de artes marciales.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo
programme.desc: Un concursante, falto de energía por la ausencia de alimentos, se quema. A los supervivientes solo les queda un par de días antes de marcharse, pero pasarlos será muy duro. Ellos elaboran un plan para lograrlo, pero podría costarles el concurso.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo
programme.desc: Tras ser picada por una araña mortal, Gwen intenta tener su revancha en la selva mexicana, a más de 50 grados de temperatura.

programme.title: El rastro
programme.desc: Durante un intento de robo de dinero destinado a comprar café, cuatro de los integrantes fueron asesinados y solo dos lograron escapar.

programme.title: El rastro
programme.desc: Valentina Maldonado Jiménez, era una niña de quince años de edad que vivía con su mamá, Blanca Jiménez, y otros siete miembros cercanos de su familia en una de las casas del conjunto residencial Alameda del Portal 2.

programme.title: El rastro
programme.desc: Tras día y medio de estar desaparecida, Heily García apareció muerta envuelta en una bolsa plástica. No se sabía nada de su cuarta hija, quien tenía solo doce días de nacida.

programme.title: Extracted
programme.desc: Extraídos desafía a once personas a sobrevivir solas en la naturaleza canadiense, mientras sus familias eligen presionarlas o usar un botón de Extracción.

programme.title: Extracted
programme.desc: Los miembros en el cuartel general deben clasificar unánimemente a todos los supervivientes del más fuerte al más débil. Los familiares tienen la oportunidad de escribir una carta a su superviviente.

programme.title: Extracted
programme.desc: Las tensiones entre las familias estallan después de que una prueba de supervivencia se lleva a cabo en total oscuridad, y los supervivientes solo cuentan con la luz que sus equipos en la sede generan para que puedan completar la prueba.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo
programme.desc: Dos personas intentan sobrevivir 21 días en los restos de una aldea abandonada en el delta del Okavango, en Botsuana, donde los agresivos hipopótamos han reclamado el territorio.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: España
programme.sub-title: S01E03 - El último hombre en pie
programme.desc: La selva se ha cobrado su primera víctima y amenaza con llevarse a más. Ahora, a los depredadores y el hambre se une la llegada de tormentas y el riesgo de hipotermia. Las tensiones llevan a una pareja al divorcio.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: España
programme.desc: Tras la tormenta, llegan los mosquitos, quienes ponen el desafío en juego. Además, el hambre agudiza el ingenio de los aventureros.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: Brasil
programme.desc: En el cuarto día del desafío, los participantes comienzan a sentir los efectos de la falta de alimentos. Tony está mentalmente agotado y Leti trabaja en el refugio debido al frío, mientras Sati y René viven en relativa paz.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: Brasil
programme.desc: Tras un tercio del desafío, la primera gran tormenta pone a prueba tanto la capacidad de los participantes para construir refugios como la unidad de los equipos en situaciones límite.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
programme.sub-title: S01E02 - Sin afectos en la Costa Perdida
programme.desc: Saltan chispas en varios campamentos. El refugio de Patrick es consumido por el fuego y desata una discusión. Darrin choca con sus compañeros por las prioridades de supervivencia. Dani y Jamie enfrentan problemas de salud, Adam prueba una estrategia.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo
programme.desc: Un biólogo marino mexicano y un pescador vikingo noruego intentan sobrevivir 21 días en la selva americana. Luchan contra lluvias torrenciales, escasez de alimentos y un incendio catastrófico en su campamento.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo
programme.desc: Perseguidos por leopardos agresivos y desprotegidos, Ángela y Chad luchan contra las circunstancias y contra ellos mismos mientras buscan redención en Sudáfrica.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo

programme.desc: Three dysfunctional co-workers embark on a mission to help their newfound friend lose his sexual innocence.

programme.desc: A frustrated shoemaker (Adam Sandler) finds a magical sewing machine that allows him to see the world in a new way by stepping into the lives of his customers.

programme.title: Retribution
programme.desc: While driving with his two kids, a man receives a phone call from an unknown assailant who claims there is a bomb in the car. Unable to exit the vehicle, he must now follow a series of twisted instructions while trying to figure out how to survive.

programme.title: Paradise
programme.desc: Carmen and Alfredo's happy relationship sours after they move into Mexico City for their careers.

programme.title: Ella es Ramona
programme.desc: A fat woman finds a beetle that improves the quality of her life.

programme.title: It's Complicated
programme.desc: Jane (Meryl Streep), a successful restaurateur, has been divorced from Jake (Alec Baldwin) for many years, although they remain friends. When an innocent meal together turns into an affair, Jane finds that she is the other woman in the now-remarried Jake's life. Meanwhile, Adam (Steve Martin), an architect hired to remodel her kitchen, is still stinging from his own divorce. He finds himself falling in love with Jane but soon realizes that he has become part of a triangle.

programme.title: The 40 Year-Old Virgin
programme.desc: Three dysfunctional co-workers embark on a mission to help their newfound friend lose his sexual innocence.

programme.title: From Dad to Worse
programme.desc: Don Servando Villegas (Héctor Bonilla) is an old-fashioned Mexican patriarch who gets kicked out of his retirement home for bad behavior. With no place else to go, Don must now live with his estranged son Francisco (Benny Ibarra de Llano) in the house that he shares with his girlfriend. New Age collides with old age as father and child soon start to clash over just about everything.

programme.title: Abel
programme.desc: With his father long gone, a disturbed youngster (Christopher Ruíz-Esparza) tries to take over his family as man of the house.

programme.title: Tear This Heart Out
programme.desc: An innocent young woman (Ana Claudia Talancón) becomes the wife of a brutal politician.

programme.title: Gimme the Power
programme.desc: A filmmaker (Demián Bichir) in Mexico City endures crime and violence on a daily basis.

programme.title: The Tiger of Santa Julia
programme.desc: A Mexican soldier (Miguel Rodarte) goes AWOL and forms an all-female gang, while a writer (Fernando Luján) records and embellishes every exploit.

programme.title: Get Married If You Can
programme.desc: While being fitted for her gown, a woman learns that her fiancé is a cheater. She treats her heartache with alcohol and winds up in the middle of the jungle.

programme.title: Juega conmigo
programme.desc: Sofía, an insecure young nanny, starts her new job taking care of two problematic kids. When their parents leave her alone with the children, they become victims of a demonic entity obsessed with playing children's games.

programme.title: The Haunting in Connecticut: Unrated
programme.desc: When their son Matt (Kyle Gallner) receives a diagnosis of cancer, Sara (Virginia Madsen) and Peter (Martin Donovan) Campbell move to Connecticut to be closer to his doctors. At first all is well, but then Matt becomes increasingly disturbed by what appears to be paranormal activity. Sara turns to a priest for help, and the ghosts are seemingly banished -- but Matt's condition takes a sudden and unexplained turn for the worse, and the lives of Sara and the rest of her family are endangered.

programme.title: A Hologram for the King
programme.desc: A beautiful doctor (Sarita Choudhury) and a wise-cracking taxi driver (Alexander Black) help an American businessman (Tom Hanks) who's trying to close the deal of a lifetime in Saudi Arabia.

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: Before he becomes world-famous mime Marcel Marceau, aspiring Jewish actor Marcel Mangel joins the French Resistance to save thousands of orphaned children from the Nazis.

programme.title: Fatale
programme.desc: After a wild one-night stand, a successful sports agent watches his perfect life slowly disappear when he discovers the sexy and mysterious woman he risked everything for is a determined police detective who entangles him in her latest investigation. As he tries desperately to put the pieces together, he falls deeper into her trap, risking his family, his career, and even his life.

programme.title: Hope Springs
programme.desc: Long-married couple Kay (Meryl Streep) and Arnold (Tommy Lee Jones) love each other, but after so many years together, Kay feels the need to spice things up and reconnect with her husband. Hearing of a renowned marriage counselor (Steve Carell) in the town of Great Hope Springs, Kay manages to persuade her stubborn mate to attend a retreat with her. As they shed their bedroom hang-ups, Kay and Arnold find that the real challenge is reigniting the spark that originally brought them together.

programme.title: The Road
programme.desc: America is a grim, gray shadow of itself after a catastrophe. A man (Viggo Mortensen) and his young son (Kodi Smit-McPhee) wander through this post-apocalyptic world, trying to keep the dream of civilization alive. They journey toward the sea, surviving as best they can on what they can scavenge, and try to avoid roving gangs of savage humans who will turn them into slaves, or worse.

programme.title: Sully
programme.desc: On Jan. 15, 2009, Capt. Chesley "Sully" Sullenberger tried to make an emergency landing in New York's Hudson River after US Airways Flight 1549 strikes a flock of geese. Miraculously, all the 155 passengers and crew survive the harrowing ordeal, and Sullenberger becomes a national hero in the eyes of the public and the media. Despite the accolades, the famed pilot now faces an investigation that threatens to destroy his career and reputation.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: Captain John Miller (Tom Hanks) takes his men behind enemy lines to find Private James Ryan, whose three brothers have been killed in combat. Surrounded by the brutal realties of war, while searching for Ryan, each man embarks upon a personal journey and discovers their own strength to triumph over an uncertain future with honor, decency and courage.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: Treasure hunter Victor "Sully" Sullivan recruits street-smart Nathan Drake to help him recover a 500-year-old lost fortune amassed by explorer Ferdinand Magellan. What starts out as a heist soon becomes a globe-trotting, white-knuckle race to reach the prize before the ruthless Santiago Moncada can get his hands on it. If Sully and Nate can decipher the clues and solve one of the world's oldest mysteries, they stand to find $5 billion in treasure -- but only if they can learn to work together.

programme.title: The Last Face
programme.desc: Miguel (Javier Bardem), a Spanish doctor, puts himself in harm's way to deliver medical treatment to the victims of military uprisings. Wren (Charlize Theron) is the spokesperson for an organization that funds medical assistance for impoverished nations the world over. They meet in Liberia, where Wren is immediately impressed with Miguel's selflessness, medical skill and charm. They begin a torrid affair, one they must learn to balance with their important work.

programme.title: Black Water
programme.desc: A deep cover operative awakens to find himself imprisoned on a submarine. With the help of a fellow prisoner and an amateur agent, he must race against the clock to escape the vessel and expose who set him up.

programme.title: El mesero
programme.desc: Propelled into a world of luxury, a charismatic young man lies about who he really is to fit in. But can he convince the elite he's one of them?

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Assassin-for-hire Elektra works for a mysterious international organization known as the Hand, for which she kills her targets without question, and in a conspicuous red bustier, no less. When the Hand asks her to kill Mark Miller and his daughter, Abby, while they're on holiday, Elektra's conscience kicks in, and she decides to protect her targets rather than eliminate them. Of course, the Hand isn't so willing to let them off the hook.

programme.desc: After fleeing from a stage show, the illusionists known as the Four Horsemen find themselves in more trouble in Macau, China. Devious tech wizard Walter Mabry forces the infamous magicians to steal a powerful chip that can control all the world's computers. Meanwhile, vengeful FBI agent Dylan Rhodes hatches his own plot against Thaddeus Bradley, the man he blames for the death of his father.
